publication_criteria: All12 actual answers pass their frozen rubrics and deterministic contracts; primary AI inspection reviews every answer; adverse separate same-model advisory judgments explicitly adjudicated. Exact prompt, runtime, data and case hashes match. No human or independent validation claim.
replication: One actual selector and one separate same-model judge per question.10 development cases and2 first-use held-out checks; no population reliability inference; cases reused after tuning become development regressions.
